issue_request: FHIR-17645 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked to correct the DataTypes page link from #xomplex to #complex and address the unlinked Repeat class in the UML diagram by linking Repeat to Timing because Repeat is part of Timing.
initial_application: Commit a9934314845956e516b115d44a5543fcfa8a7494, "GF#17645 - fix broken link", changed source/datatypes.html from #xomplex to #complex. The Jira comments say the Repeat link was left for later and then already fixed, but no FHIR-17645-tagged core source commit was found for that second part.
additional_context: The current DataTypes page and datatypes/types2.diagram are active build inputs. The diagram input still includes Timing.repeat, and the live build shows Repeat as an unlinked diagram title while Timing is linked and Repeat child rows link to Timing.repeat definitions. Core depends on org.hl7.fhir:kindling 1.25.5-SNAPSHOT; current Kindling links class titles only when drawClass receives link=true and calls child/backbone drawClass with link=false.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source file was changed because the typo is already fixed in active source and the remaining literal link behavior would require a Kindling renderer change or a deliberate human decision to add redundant prose outside the diagram.
